title: The Neurobiology of Compassion Fatigue: When Caring Hurts

guest.name: Dr. Kenji Sato
guest.bio: Director of the Cognitive Resilience Institute. Researches autonomic nervous system burnout in first responders and therapists.

summary: Exploring why frontline caregivers experience emotional numbness, the vagal nerve mechanics behind secondary trauma, and daily neuro-somatic resets.
takeaways: Compassion fatigue is physiological downregulation, not a moral failure.
The 3-minute bilateral stimulation technique for emergency resetting.
How to build clinical boundaries that preserve empathy.

title: Unspoken Grief: Navigating Ambiguous Loss in Family Caregiving

guest.name: Elena Vance, MSW
guest.bio: Specializes in dementia caregiver support and chronic illness bereavement. Author of 'The Living Goodbye'.

summary: A compassionate dialogue on the psychological weight of grieving someone who is still physically present, such as in progressive cognitive decline.
takeaways: Defining ambiguous loss and freeing families from caregiver guilt.
Creating micro-rituals of acknowledgment within everyday care routines.
Communicating through non-verbal somatic presence when memory fades.
